description: This file contains mock implementations for file I/O functions such as fgets, popen, and pclose, used for unit testing. It references an external mock object and provides extern C interfaces to override standard library functions for testing purposes.

methods.name: char * fgets(char * str,int n,FILE * stream)
methods.description: Mocked version of fgets that delegates to g_fileIOMock if available, otherwise returns NULL.

methods.name: FILE * popen(const char * command,const char * type)
methods.description: Mocked version of popen that delegates to g_fileIOMock if available, otherwise returns NULL.

methods.name: int pclose(FILE * stream)
methods.description: Mocked version of pclose that delegates to g_fileIOMock if available, otherwise returns 0.

ctags.name: fgets
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" char * fgets(char * str, int n, FILE * stream)$/

ctags.name: popen
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" FILE * popen(const char * command, const char * type)$/
